test_bar_align_left: test DataFrame.style.bar with align='left' renders bars from left edge for positive values
test_bar_align_zero: test DataFrame.style.bar with align='zero' renders bars centered at zero for mixed positive and negative values
test_bar_align_mid: test DataFrame.style.bar with align='mid' renders bars from median for positive values
test_bar_vmin_vmax_clipping: test DataFrame.style.bar with vmin and vmax clips bar widths to the specified range
test_bar_custom_colors: test DataFrame.style.bar with color=['red','green'] renders different colors for negative and positive values
